record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare POWER_HUG: Stufful (1 star) and Bewear (2 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index). Both have maxPP 100, range 1, no passive.
record.summary: Single-target. In this order on the cast target: (1) triggerLocked, (2) triggerParalysis, (3) SPECIAL damage (raw 40/80/160/320 by caster stars). Lock and paralysis both request 3000/3000/6000/10000 ms by stars (10000 fallback). The statuses are applied before and independently of the damage, so a damage block (protect / skydiving / magicBounce) does not stop them; each status has its own guard (lock: skydiving, Rune Protect, IMMUNITY_LOCKED, already locked, ccCooldown; paralysis: Rune Protect, IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS). Lock forces range 1 and prevents the target moving or being moved; paralysis halves its attack speed.

targeting.note: No search, line or area: all three calls use the target passed to process.

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x (1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with a DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 when the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce (see core-mechanics §A/§J). No heal, PP or shield is requested by this ability.

statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit: the duration is the flat table value and no apBoost exists on triggerLocked.
statusEffects.resolution: applied only if the target is not already locked, not skydiving, has no Rune Protect and lacks IMMUNITY_LOCKED, and its ccCooldown is <= 0 (an existing lock is not refreshed or extended). Applied duration = requested /2 if the target is enraged, then the target's reductions (Swift Swim x0.7, Hydration x0.5, Water Veil / Surge Surfer x0.3, Odd Keystone -10% each), rounded. On application a target with range != 1 is sent back to the moving state and its range is set to 1; a locked unit cannot move (canMove) or be moved (canBeMoved) and cannot dodge basic attacks. When the timer ends the range is restored from baseRange (Wide Lens, Long Wand for Fairy) and ccCooldown is set to at least CC_COOLDOWN. Casting is not blocked by lock (canCast does not read it).

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars beyond the table, AP or crit: the apBoost argument of triggerParalysis is left at its default false.
statusEffects.resolution: applied unless the target has Rune Protect or IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS; applied duration = requested x1.3 in a STORM (with a further -20% per Electric Quartz on the target's player), then the target's reductions, rounded; the timer is replaced only if the new duration exceeds the remaining one. A Cheri Berry holder eats the berry on application. While paralysed, the unit's attack cooldown uses half its speed. Unlike lock, paralysis is not refused while skydiving, and has no ccCooldown guard.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars (1 and 2 for the listed units, bare factory values); the 3-star (160 damage, 6000 ms) and 4-star (320 damage, 10000 ms) columns are not reachable by the bare factory star counts. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined. The status duration is the same for 1 and 2 stars (3000).

record.positionalConditions: None read in the strategy: requiresTarget true, the target is whatever the cast supplies. Range 1 for both units.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP. A target already locked is not re-locked and the lock timer is not extended; after a lock ends ccCooldown blocks a new lock. A longer paralysis replaces a shorter remaining one; a shorter one does not.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 40/80 (1/2 stars), lock 3000 ms and paralysis 3000 ms on the target. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied lock/paralysis durations are adjusted on the target (enraged, storm, reductions) and may be refused by the guards listed; durations are the requested value, not a guaranteed result.
